name: lexicona-openapi-tooling
description: Isolated build-time OpenAPI to TypeScript generation

scripts.generate: cd ../../frontend && npm run tooling:build && node --input-type=module -e "import { generate } from './artifacts/coverage-tooling/generate.js'; generate(process.cwd(), ['generate']);"
scripts.check: cd ../../frontend && npm run tooling:build && node --input-type=module -e "import { generate } from './artifacts/coverage-tooling/generate.js'; generate(process.cwd(), ['check']);"
